page.layout: One printed page. Top: head "TABVLA XLVI" with page number at top right. Then one large tree diagram of braces and boxes, with the upper-right boxes continuing to the top. Below it, the head "TABVLA XLVII" and a second diagram. Then the head "TABVLA XLIIX" and a third diagram, ending with the gathering signature at the foot. Cut-off text at the left edge, outside the diagrams, is described under notes.

main_text.head: TABVLA XLVI
main_text.l: Intrinseca & producitiua: vt est causa quaelibet. Huc referendi gradus cognationis: idque vel
Recta: vt, Maiores, Tritauus, Tritauia; Atauus, atauia; Abauus, Proauus, Pater, mater, filius, filia, nepos.
Collaterali: Aequali: vt frater, soror, patrueles, consobrini, Inaequali: vt patruus, patruus, amita, auunculus, matertera.
Secundario: vt gradus affinitatis; priuignus, priuigna, leuir, glos, fororius, fratria, socer, gener, socrus, nurus, vitricus, nouerca.
Extrinseca: Regentis: huc omnis norma & regula. Adiacentis; quae vel Locus, seu locatio. Tempus.
Quantitate, & dicitur ἰσότης, id est aequalitas, quo pertinet Proportio.
Repraesentatione: & dicitur signatio, seu significatio, quo pertinent omnia signa naturalia.
4. Dispositio: vt est ordo & situs partium in mundo, & corporibus mundanis.
ἐκ θέσεως, ex institutione, coqi vel
main_text.head: TABVLA XLVII
main_text.l: Lex, seu ius naturae à Deo repetitum.
Ecclesiae caput CHRISTVM mediatorem in quo officium
Verbum Dei: quod est signum formaliter confideratum.
main_text.head: TABVLA XLIIX
main_text.l: Maioris, vt Regnum, Rex, Princeps, Comes, Baro, Dominus, Consul.
Societates & confoederationes quaelibet; & contractus qui vocantur Innominati, item pactum, testamentum, obligatio.
Contractus speciatim dicti & ciuiles; qui sunt vel
Mutuum, Commodatum, Depositum, Oppignoratio, Emptio, venditio.
Distinctio & dispositio, huc pertinet acies, ordo, & methodus disciplinarum.
Sigillum, diadema, sceptrum, fasces, Tessera militaris, Pignus quodlibet & arrha, Limes, signum terminatum.

page.notes: Cut-off margin text at the left edge (partly visible, not legible as a whole): "710 est", "ex insti-", "Diuino," and similar fragments, not transcribed. Several diagram words are blurred or cut by the binding and are copied as far as legible. The Greek words in the first diagram are as far as they can be read. The heading "XLIIX" is printed as shown; it is the Tabula XLIX.
